looks.description: A man with a gross scar on his head, in a shirt, with bare legs. He wears boxers and knee pads, a jacket, a cloak around his neck that smolders at a fairy's touch, and a gauntlet on his fist. The long-dormant eye of the bedlam bride on his chest is open, burning a hole in his shirt.
looks.change: Shirt, bare legs, smoldering cloak, open chest eye (this scene only)

looks.description: A long-haired dachshund (wiener dog) with ridiculously short, stubby legs, no thumbs, paws and a wagging tail, wearing resized boxers that sit awkwardly, a jacket, a cloak and a bandana hanging around its neck, with rings and the gauntlet unequipped. A swirl tattoo is on a palm.
looks.change: Dachshund form (this scene only)

looks.description: A man with a swirl tattoo on his palm, wearing a jacket and a cloak. A four-leaf clover patch is sewn onto the jacket above a Midnight Epicure patch. He wears an enormous, struggling pig against his chest in a backpack carrier.
looks.change: Four-leaf clover and Midnight Epicure patches; pig in backpack carrier (this scene only)
